 Share 1h ago 12.28 EST And at Stamford Bridge, Jacob Steinberg watched Leeds United earn a huge 4-1 win against Chelsea.
 Noah Okafor at the double as Leeds hit back to demolish sorry Chelsea Read more Share 1h ago 12.26 EST Ben Fisher was at Villa Park as a goalless draw played out between Aston Villa and Sunderland.
 Aston Villa held at home by dogged Sunderland in tense draw Read more Share 1h ago 12.24 EST Bournemouth extended their winning run to eight in all competitions as Evanilson scored for the sixth Premier League game in a row in a 2-0 victory over Nottingham Forest.
 Bournemouth’s Evanilson and Kluivert sink Forest to make it eight wins in a row Read more Share 2h ago 12.18 EST Coventry City ruined Thomas Frank’s first game in charge of Crystal Palace with a 3-2 win. Jonathan Wilson was at that game.
 Coventry edge thriller to keep Crystal Palace bottom and ruin Thomas Frank’s start Read more Share 2h ago 12.11 EST Ed Aarons was at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium this afternoon as Spurs cruised to a 2-0 win against Ipswich Town.

 Share 2h ago 11.59 EST Full-time
 Let’s take a look at the scores…
 Share 2h ago 11.56 EST GOAL! Chelsea 1-4 Leeds United (Brenden Aaronson, 90+1)
 Aaronson makes it FOUR for Leeds United!
 The winger is played through and makes a run into the box before cutting back and finding a gap between Emiliano Martínez and the near post.
 Share 2h ago 11.53 EST League One: What a comeback from Oxford United! After being 3-0 down, they now lead Wycombe 4-3 thanks to a 95th-minute strike from Gatlin O’Donkor!
 Share 2h ago 11.52 EST The full-time whistles are beginning to sound across the grounds. We’ll bring you the results shortly…
 Share 2h ago 11.49 EST GOAL! Coventry City 3-2 Crystal Palace (Dwight McNeil OG, 85)
 That could be the winner!
 McNeil deflects the ball into his own net to give Coventry the lead once again!
 Share 2h ago 11.46 EST Scottish Premiership: Aberdeen have restored their two-goal lead against Kilmarnock thanks to Findlay Marshall. Four minutes of normal time left to play and that should wrap up the win.
 Share 2h ago 11.45 EST There are roughly five minutes left plus added time in these 3pm fixtures. Still time for plenty more goals.
 Share 2h ago 11.42 EST Championship: George Thomason scores to put Wrexham 1-0 up against Lincoln. Meanwhile, Matt Godden has got one back for Charlton against Wolves to make it 2-1 with eight minutes to play.
 Share 2h ago 11.39 EST League One: And there’s the equaliser! From 3-0 down, Oxford United have scored three goals in eight minutes to go level against Wycombe.
 Mark Harris gets the latest goal.
 Share 2h ago 11.38 EST League One: Oxford United get another goal back against Wycombe thanks to a Cameron Brannagan penalty – could we see a stunning comeback? It’s currently 3-2 with 10 minutes to play.
 Wycombe are also down to NINE players following red cards for Dan Casey and Luke Leahy.
 Share 2h ago 11.34 EST Premier League live scores 
 Chelsea 1-3 Leeds United

 Share 2h ago 11.31 EST Scottish Premiership: Killian Phillips scores a penalty to get a goal back for St. Mirren against Celtic.
 Share 2h ago 11.30 EST League One: Oxford United get a goal back against Wycombe to close the gap and make it 3-1. Elsewhere, Stockport go 2-0 up against Cambridge and Leyton Orient extend their lead to 4-1 against AFC Wimbledon.
 Share 2h ago 11.24 EST Championship: Luca Bombino receives a red card and Stoke are down to 10 men. They lead 1-0 but there are more than 25 minutes still to play.
 Share 3h ago 11.22 EST GOAL! Chelsea 1-3 Leeds United (Noah Okafor, 58)
 Okafor gets his second of the game and Leeds have a two-goal advantage!
 The forward has four Chelsea defenders around him inside the box but manages to find the bottom-right corner with his shot.
 View image in fullscreen Noah Okafor of Leeds United scores his second goal. Photograph: Graeme Wilcockson/Focus Images Ltd/Shutterstock Share Updated at  11.35 EST 3h ago 11.20 EST Championship: Konstantinos Mavropanos equalises for West Ham against Preston at London Stadium.
 Meanwhile, Jordan Ayew makes it 3-0 to Sheffield United against Watford.
 Share 3h ago 11.18 EST Scottish Premiership: Tyreece John-Jules scores for Kilmarnock to close the gap and make it 3-2 against Aberdeen. We could be in for a thrilling end to that game!
 Share Updated at  11.18 EST 3h ago 11.16 EST GOAL! Chelsea 1-2 Leeds United (Dominic Calvert-Lewin, 53)
 Calvert-Lewin scores the penalty and Leeds take the lead!
 That’s his 100th club career goal. A huge milestone.
 View image in fullscreen Dominic Calvert-Lewin scores from the penalty spot. Photograph: Paul Marriott/Shutterstock View image in fullscreen Lewin celebrates. Photograph: Daniel Hambury/EPA Share Updated at  11.28 EST 3h ago 11.14 EST PENALTY! Leeds United
 Leeds have a penalty against Chelsea following a handball from Morgan Rogers.
 Share 3h ago 11.12 EST GOAL! Tottenham 2-0 Ipswich Town (Dominic Solanke, 52)
 Solanke doubles the advantage!
 Williams-Barnett makes a brilliant run down the wing before crossing into Solanke, who taps the ball home from a few yards out.
 Share 3h ago 11.09 EST Championship: George Hirst gives Stoke a 1-0 lead against Birmingham early in the second half, while Adam Armstrong fires Wolves ahead against Charlton.

 Share 3h ago 10.52 EST Half-time
 It’s been a goal fest! Let’s take a look at the scores…
 Share 3h ago 10.51 EST GOAL! Bournemouth 2-0 Nottingham Forest (Justin Kluivert, 45+3)
 Kluivert makes it two for Bournemouth just before the break by tapping home a cross from Marcus Tavernier!
 View image in fullscreen Justin Kluivert of AFC Bournemouth scores the second goal beating Matz Sels (26) of Nottingham Forest. Photograph: Graham Hunt/ProSports/Shutterstock Share Updated at  10.58 EST 3h ago 10.50 EST GOAL! Coventry City 2-2 Crystal Palace (Jørgen Strand Larsen, 45+1)
